basis: Valuer-General Victoria annual median house sale price (all sales in the calendar year), repeated over the year's four quarters
name: Melbourne
notes: Melbourne: Valuer-General Victoria's ANNUAL median house price for Melbourne Metropolitan Area, 1995 to 2025, repeated over the four quarters of each year (the Valuer-General publishes no longer quarterly series; its quarterly suburb workbooks start in 2023, see au_vic_vpsr). Medians of all sales in the calendar year, not mix-adjusted. Districts: 31 metropolitan municipalities (annual medians from 1995) and 371 suburbs with houses and 268 with units, annual medians 2015 onward (years with fewer than 10 sales, flagged '^', are left out; a suburb needs at least 8 years), each placed in the municipality holding most of its residential Mesh Blocks (ABS allocation files). The year after the last full year is year-to-date in the workbook and is not used.
